packs.description: Built-in NPDev approvals pack: anyone with the 'requester' role files an approval request, a person with the 'approver' role decides it from My tasks (approve or reject, with a comment), and the pack records who decided, when and why. The two roles are logical: the importing app binds them to its own role names with provides.roleBindings { "requester": ..., "approver": ... }, and composition refuses when either is unbound. A resumed flow applies the decision as the person who started it and without that person's roles, so the rules also admit the platform's trusted resume principal (role ADMIN); who filed a request is the starter of its flow execution (My tasks shows it).
packs.author: NPDev

packs.description: Portable credential bond for an identity::User: a password hash tied 1:1 to an identity user. Depends on the identity pack for the actual account (username/roles/etc.) -- this pack only adds the credential.
packs.author: Marcelo Giazzon
